title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Priya Shah
description: Motivation: make it easier for developers to get started with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) agents that use tool-calling. This PR adds step-by-step quickstarts (Python + TypeScript), reusable RAG templates, and a new docs guide for agent tool-calling patterns. It also updates the docs site TOC and sidebar so the new guides are discoverable from the RAG section. Testing: local docs build, automated docs lint, and a small integration test in the examples repo that exercises tool-calling stubs. Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart and example script - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and example - [x] Add YAML templates for common RAG agent flows (email assistant, support search) - [x] Update docs sidebar and TOC - [x] Add diagrams and inline examples for tool-calling patterns Notes: kept templates intentionally minimal and linked to the examples directory for full runnable code. No code changes to runtime or SDKs; purely docs and examples. If follow-ups are needed we should add deeper end-to-end examples that wire an external tool (calendar, search) in the examples playground (ENG-9583).
commits: Add initial quickstart templates for RAG agents
Docs: add tool-calling examples and usage notes
